provenance.document: Complete front page of The New York Times, scanned.
provenance.source: Reconstructed from the metrics the production workflow (YOLO DocLayNet regions + docTR OCR) reported for this page. It is NOT a full capture of that run: the reported keys below are its measurements, the declared keys were filled in here so the record is loadable, and the page text was not stored. Running the v9 classifier on it reproduces the reported result exactly, which is what it is good for.

declared_keys.total_pages: 1 — a single front page; needed for the multipage channel.
declared_keys.measured_page_ratio: 1.0 — the layout channel produced the reported region measurements.
declared_keys.alnum_character_count: 4040 — derived as 808 words x 5 characters. Its only consumer is the 20-character abstention floor, so any value above 20 behaves identically.

provenance.absent_keys: Every other feature is absent and therefore reads as 0 or unavailable. That can only withhold evidence, never add it. classification_text is deliberately not stored: the production record reported counts, and the page's text is not this repository's to carry.
provenance.replace_when: Once YOLO + docTR can run here, replace this file with the classification_features persisted directly by the real execution, and change fixture_kind to captured_from_production_run.
